meals.name: Baked Farro with Lentils Tomato and Feta

recipe.name: Baked Farro with Lentils Tomato and Feta

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil, plus more for drizzling
tomato purée (or your favorite tomato sauce)
fresh oregano, thyme, rosemary or basil sprigs (optional) or dried herb

prepTasks: Cut feta into 1/4-inch slices and break each in half
steps: Heat the oven to 400 degrees and place one rack 6 inches from the broiler.
Place the farro in an 8-by-8-inch (2-quart) broiler-proof baking dish and toast in the oven for 10 to 15 minutes.
Remove the dish and scatter the lentils over the farro.
While the farro toasts, warm the olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the onion, season with salt and pepper, and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5 to 7 minutes.
Add the garlic and red-pepper flakes and cook until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes.
Add the tomato purée, herb sprigs if using, and 2 1/2 cups water. Season with salt and pepper and bring to a boil.
Gently pour the tomato sauce over the lentils and farro and stir to combine.
Bake, stirring halfway through, until the lentils and farro are tender, 40 to 50 minutes. If the mixture looks dry, add 1/4 cup water.
Remove the dish from the oven and turn on the broiler.
Stir the lentils and farro once more and discard the herb sprigs.
Top with the feta slices and drizzle with olive oil.
Broil until the feta is molten and charred in spots, 6 to 8 minutes, rotating the pan after 2 or 3 minutes if needed for even cooking.
